entries.jp: {v:0008}例の２人組はここにいるのでしょうか？
entries.en: {v:0008}I wonder if those two are here.

entries.jp: {v:0009}おじさんの言ってた、２人組ってここにいるのかな？
entries.en: {v:0009}Could the two that man mentioned be here?

entries.jp: {v:000A}行ってみりゃわかるだろ。
entries.en: {v:000A}We'll find out if we go look.

entries.jp: {FFF0}安全第一{FFF1}{n}　　　　{FFEE}頂上{FFF1}　：　{FFEF}魔水晶採掘場{FFF1}{n}　　　　{FFEE}右{FFF1}　　：　{FFEF}旧坑道{FFF1}（封鎖中）{n}　　　　　　　　　　許可なき者の立入を禁ず
entries.en: {FFF0}Safety First{FFF1}{n}{FFEE}Summit{FFF1}: {FFEF}Magic Crystal Mine{FFF1}{n}{FFEE}Right{FFF1}: {FFEF}Old Mine Tunnels{FFF1} (Closed){p}No unauthorized entry.

entries.jp: {v:0033}おいおい、早くしねぇと薬の効果が切れるだろ？
entries.en: {v:0033}Hey, pick up the pace! The medicine's gonna wear off!

entries.jp: こら、どこへ行くつもりだ！{n}とっとと、戻れ！
entries.en: Hey! Where do you think you're going?! Get back here!

entries.jp: 申し訳ありません。{n}現在は封鎖されています。
entries.en: I'm sorry. This area is currently closed.

entries.jp: {v:002C}やったね。{n}全然気づかれないよ！
entries.en: {v:002C}We did it! They haven't noticed a thing!
{v:002D}Shh!

entries.jp: {v:002E}おい、何か言ったか？
entries.en: {v:002E}Hey, did you say something?

entries.jp: {v:002F}何も言ってないぞ。
entries.en: {v:002F}I didn't say a thing.
{v:0030}Must've imagined it...

entries.jp: だめだよ。{n}警備員の目が厳しくて、とても入れない。
entries.en: It's no use. The guards are watching too closely.{n}There's no way in.

entries.jp: 調査隊を送ってすぐに崩落事故があったんだ。{n}関係者以外は入れちゃもらえないだろうな。
entries.en: There was a cave-in right after they sent in the{n}survey team. I doubt they'll let anyone in who{n}isn't involved.

entries.jp: {v:0019}怪しいな。{n}こっちを見るなり追い払いやがった‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0019}Something's fishy. They chased us off the moment{n}they laid eyes on us...

entries.jp: {v:001A}怪しいよね～！
entries.en: {v:001A}Pretty fishy, huh?!

entries.jp: {v:001B}見つからないように近づければいいんだけどね。
entries.en: {v:001B}If only we could get closer without being spotted.

entries.jp: {v:001C}夜にこっそり来るとか？
entries.en: {v:001C}Maybe we could sneak over at night?

entries.jp: {v:001D}かえって怪しまれるだけだ。{n}他の手段を考えた方がいい。
entries.en: {v:001D}That'd just make them more suspicious. We'd better{n}find another way.

entries.jp: {v:001F}う～ん、こうも邪険に扱われると、{n}よけい中が知りたくなる～！
entries.en: {v:001F}Ugh, being treated like that just makes me want to see{n}inside even more!

entries.jp: {v:0020}だが見つかっただけで追い返されちまう。
entries.en: {v:0020}But they'll chase us off the second they spot us.

entries.jp: {v:0021}こっそり入れればいいんだけどね。
entries.en: {v:0021}If only we could sneak in.

entries.jp: {v:0022}普通のやり方じゃ、無理みたい。
entries.en: {v:0022}It looks like the usual ways won't work.

entries.jp: {v:0024}透明人間にでもなれれば気づかれないかも‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0024}Maybe they wouldn't notice us if we could{n}turn invisible...

entries.jp: {v:0025}そういえば、学院で透明になる薬を研究してる人が{n}いるよ。
entries.en: {v:0025}Come to think of it, someone at the Academy is{n}researching a medicine that makes you invisible.

entries.jp: {v:0027}見つからないように入れればいいんだけどね。
entries.en: {v:0027}If only we could get in without being spotted.

entries.jp: {v:0028}確か、見えなくなる薬を研究してる人が{n}いたような‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0028}I'm sure there was someone researching a medicine{n}that makes you invisible...

entries.jp: {v:0016}ここは２０年前から閉鎖されている。{n}俺たちが警備しているから大丈夫だ。
entries.en: {v:0016}This place has been closed for twenty years. We're{n}guarding it, so there's nothing to worry about.

entries.jp: {v:0017}調査なら上でやるんだな。{n}さあ、帰れ、帰れ！
entries.en: {v:0017}If you're here to investigate, do it up top. Now get{n}going! Move!

entries.jp: {v:0018}何よ、あの態度！
entries.en: {v:0018}What's with that attitude?!

entries.jp: {v:0026}また来やがったか！
entries.en: {v:0026}You lot again?!

entries.jp: {v:0088}さあ、帰れ、帰れ！
entries.en: {v:0088}Now get going! Move!

entries.jp: {v:002A}本当に消えた！
entries.en: {v:002A}We really disappeared!

entries.jp: {v:002B}今のうちに通り抜けよう。
entries.en: {v:002B}Let's slip through while we can.

entries.jp: おい、場所を考えろ。{n}あいつらに見つかっちまうぞ。
entries.en: Hey, watch where you do that. They'll spot us.

entries.jp: {v:001E}調査なら上でやるんだな。{n}さあ、帰れ、帰れ！
entries.en: {v:001E}If you're here to investigate, do it up top. Now get{n}going! Move!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0059}許せねぇ！{n}ヴェンツェルの奴、絶対に許せねぇ！
entries.en: ...{v:0059}I won't forgive him! I'll never forgive that{n}bastard Wenzel!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:000B}まだ我々にたてつく奴が残っていたのか。
entries.en: ...{v:000B}So there are still some who dare defy us.

entries.jp: {v:005A}おとなしくヴェンツェル様に従えばよいものを‥‥。
entries.en: {v:005A}If only you would quietly obey Wenzel-sama...

entries.jp: {v:000C}まさか‥‥！？{p}{v:000D}父さん、母さん！？
entries.en: {v:000C}It can't be...!{p}{v:000D}Father?! Mother?!

entries.jp: {v:000E}エリオット！？
entries.en: {v:000E}Elliot?!
...{v:000F}Why are you here...?

entries.jp: {v:0010}まさか、２人がこんなことをするなんて‥‥。{p}{FC02}{v:0011}もうやめて下さい！
entries.en: {v:0010}I never imagined you two would do something like this...{p}{FC02}{v:0011}Please, stop this!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0012}私たちはヴェンツェル様の部下なのだよ。
entries.en: ...{v:0012}We serve Wenzel-sama, you see.
{v:0013}No... Father... Mother...

entries.jp: {v:0014}私のことを母と呼ぶのはやめてもらおうか。{n}お前の母親役はもう終わったのだからね。
entries.en: {v:0014}I would ask you to stop calling me Mother. My role as{n}your mother is over.

entries.jp: {v:0015}お前が育つまでの１４年間。{n}私たちは親代わりをするという任務を果たした。{p}{v:0016}任務が終われば、もう親子ごっこは終わりだ。
entries.en: {v:0015}For fourteen years, while you grew up, we carried out{n}our mission of acting as your parents.{p}{v:0016}Now that our mission is over, so is this game of{n}playing family.

entries.jp: {v:0017}ヴェンツェル様の敵は実力で排除する！
entries.en: {v:0017}We will eliminate Wenzel-sama's enemies by force!

entries.jp: {v:0019}どうしたの、ルイセちゃん？
entries.en: {v:0019}What's wrong, Luise-chan?

entries.jp: {v:001A}この声、聞き覚えない？
entries.en: {v:001A}Doesn't that voice sound familiar?

entries.jp: ・ヴェンツェルの部下
entries.en: ・Wenzel's subordinates

entries.jp: ・エリオットの育ての親
entries.en: ・Elliot's foster parents

entries.jp: ・わからない
entries.en: ・I don't know

entries.jp: {v:001E}そんなの、当たり前でしょ！
entries.en: {v:001E}Well, obviously!

entries.jp: {v:001F}あの人たち、{n}エリオット君の育ての親だよ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:001F}Those two are Elliot-kun's foster parents...
{v:0020}Now that you mention it...

entries.jp: {v:0021}間違いないよ！
entries.en: {v:0021}No doubt about it!

entries.jp: {v:0022}あの人たち、{n}エリオット君の育ての親だよ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0022}Those two are Elliot-kun's foster parents...

entries.jp: {v:0023}その様だな。{n}俺も覚えてるぜ。
entries.en: {v:0023}Looks that way. I remember them too.

entries.jp: {v:0024}今のお前たちはヴェンツェル様に敵対するものだ。
entries.en: {v:0024}You are now enemies of Wenzel-sama.

entries.jp: {v:005B}敵は実力で排除する！
entries.en: {v:005B}We will eliminate our enemies by force!

entries.jp: まさか旧坑道で盗掘が行われていたとは‥‥。{n}それに見張りをしていた奴もグルだったなんて‥‥。{p}何でそんなことに気づかなかったんだ！
entries.en: I never imagined people were mining illegally in the old{n}mine tunnels... And the guards were in on it too...{p}How could I have missed it?!

entries.jp: あなた達のおかげで、{n}またここに立つことが出来ますよ。
entries.en: Thanks to all of you, I can stand here again.

entries.jp: {v:0010}ここは現在採掘が行われてる部分だ。{p}{v:0011}旧坑道はもっと下の方にあるが、{n}現在は閉鎖されているよ。
entries.en: {v:0010}This is the section we're mining now.{p}{v:0011}The old mine tunnels are farther down, but they're{n}closed at the moment.

entries.jp: {v:0012}ここで採れる魔水晶はとても純度が高いんだ。{n}おかげで採掘も難しいよ。
entries.en: {v:0012}The magic crystals we mine here are extremely pure.{n}That makes them hard to extract, though.

entries.jp: {v:0013}この山全体が１つの水晶だなんて信じられるか？{n}でも本当なんだぞ。{n}学者さん達がちゃんと調査したんだからな。
entries.en: {v:0013}Can you believe this whole mountain is one crystal? It's{n}true, though. The scholars did a proper survey.

entries.jp: 旧坑道からときおり聞こえてきたあの声や音は{n}盗掘者の仕業だったのか‥‥。
entries.en: So those voices and noises we sometimes heard from{n}the old mine tunnels came from the tomb robbers...

entries.jp: そういえば、ここを占拠してた二人組だけど、{n}俺たちには手出ししなかったなぁ‥‥。
entries.en: Come to think of it, those two who took over this{n}place never laid a hand on us...

entries.jp: {v:0014}ああ、やっぱりここは怖いなぁ‥‥。{n}だって幽霊が出るんだぜ？{p}{v:0015}旧坑道の奥から声が聞こえたり‥‥ああ、怖い！
entries.en: {v:0014}Oh, this place still gives me the creeps... It's haunted,{n}you know!{p}{v:0015}You can hear voices deep in the old mine tunnels... Ooh,{n}it's scary!

entries.jp: {v:0089}あ、効果が切れちゃった‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0089}Oh, it wore off...

entries.jp: {v:0034}さて、この中に幽霊が出ると言う話だが‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0034}Well, they say there are ghosts in here...

entries.jp: {FFF3}‥{FE14}‥{FE14}{FFF4}{v:0035}やっぱりやめにしない？
entries.en: {FFF3}...{FE14}...{FE14}{FFF4}{v:0035}Maybe we should just forget about this?

entries.jp: {v:0036}どうしたの、ルイセちゃん？{n}ひょっとして、幽霊、怖い？
entries.en: {v:0036}What's wrong, Luise-chan? Don't tell me you're scared{n}of ghosts?

entries.jp: {v:0037}やっぱり、怖いよぉ～。{n}だって、死んでる人でしょ？{n}それなのに、出てくるなんて‥‥。{p}{FFF5}‥‥{v:0038}うぅ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0037}I can't help being scared... They're dead people, aren't{n}they? But they still come back...{p}{FFF5}...{v:0038}Ooh...

entries.jp: {v:0039}バカ言うな。{n}この世の中に幽霊なんているはずねぇだろ？{n}お前もそう思うよな？
entries.en: {v:0039}Don't talk nonsense. There's no such thing as ghosts.{n}You know that, right?

entries.jp: 幽霊はいると思いますか？
entries.en: Do you believe in ghosts?

entries.jp: ・存在しない
entries.en: ・They don't exist

entries.jp: ・見たことがある
entries.en: ・I've seen one

entries.jp: ・黙っている
entries.en: ・Stay silent
{v:003A}Right?

entries.jp: {v:003B}何言ってんのよ！{n}アタシたち、幽霊にあったじゃない！
entries.en: {v:003B}What are you talking about?! We met a{n}ghost, remember?!

entries.jp: {v:003C}え～っ、本当なのお兄ちゃん！？
entries.en: {v:003C}Whaaat?! Is that true, Big Brother?!

entries.jp: {v:003D}お兄さまって凄～い！
entries.en: {v:003D}You're amaaazing, Big Brother!

entries.jp: {v:003E}そうよね、直接会っちゃったもんね。
entries.en: {v:003E}That's right! We met one face to face.

entries.jp: {FFF5}{v:003F}え～っ、やぁだぁ～‥‥。{n}本当なのお兄ちゃん！？
entries.en: {FFF5}{v:003F}Whaaat? Nooo... Is that true, Big Brother?!

entries.jp: {v:0040}本当だもん♪
entries.en: {v:0040}It's true, all right♪

entries.jp: {v:0041}お兄さまって凄～い！
entries.en: {v:0041}You're amaaazing, Big Brother!

entries.jp: {v:0042}何だ、お前も怖いのか？
entries.en: {v:0042}What, you're scared too?
{FB00}{v:0043}But... I mean... right?

entries.jp: {v:0044}本当にいるかどうかは別として、{n}魔水晶の横流しと幽霊騒ぎ‥‥。{n}どうも怪しいな。
entries.en: {v:0044}Ghosts or no ghosts, magic crystal smuggling and a{n}haunting... Something's fishy.

entries.jp: {v:0045}とにかく調べてみればハッキリするわよ。
entries.en: {v:0045}Anyway, we'll know for sure once we look into it.

entries.jp: {v:0046}それより天井が崩れないかが心配だよ～！{n}だって一度崩れてるんでしょ？
entries.en: {v:0046}I'm more worried about the ceiling falling in! It collapsed{n}once already, didn't it?

entries.jp: {v:0047}あ、そうだったっけ‥‥。{p}{v:0048}ティピ、お願い。
entries.en: {v:0047}Oh, that's right...{p}{v:0048}Tippi, would you check?
{v:0049}Let's see...

entries.jp: {v:004A}結構しっかりしてるわね。{n}全然崩れそうな心配はないわよ。
entries.en: {v:004A}It's pretty solid. No need to worry about it collapsing{n}at all!

entries.jp: {v:004B}普通の鉱山と違って、{n}この山全体が１個の水晶だからな。{n}そう簡単に、崩れることはねぇさ。
entries.en: {v:004B}Unlike a normal mine, this whole mountain's one crystal.{n}It won't cave in that easily.

entries.jp: {v:0087}もう透明薬はないんだぞ？{n}このまま進むしかねぇだろ？
entries.en: {v:0087}We're out of invisibility medicine, remember? We've got{n}no choice but to keep going.

entries.jp: {v:004E}水晶が崩れた跡みたい。
entries.en: {v:004E}It looks like some crystal collapsed here.

entries.jp: {v:004F}調査団が遭った崩落事故の現場じゃねぇか？
entries.en: {v:004F}Could this be where the survey team got caught in{n}that cave-in?

entries.jp: {v:0050}でも誰かがきれいに片づけたみたいだよ。
entries.en: {v:0050}But it looks like someone cleaned it all up.

entries.jp: {v:0051}ますます怪しいな。
entries.en: {v:0051}This just gets fishier.

entries.jp: {v:0069}ねぇねぇ、あそこも水晶の破片が山になってるよ！
entries.en: {v:0069}Hey, look! There's a pile of crystal fragments over{n}there too!

entries.jp: {v:006A}行ってみようよ。
entries.en: {v:006A}Let's go take a look.

entries.jp: {v:0053}さっさと詰め込むんだ！{n}人目がないうちに外へ運び出すぞ。
entries.en: {v:0053}Hurry up and pack it in! We'll haul it out while no{n}one's looking.

entries.jp: {v:0054}何だか俺たちのことを探ってる奴らが{n}いるらしいからな。
entries.en: {v:0054}Sounds like someone's been nosing around in{n}our business.

entries.jp: {v:0055}そろそろ控えた方がいいかも知れん。{n}グレンガルのダンナは、{n}もう買ってくれないみたいだしな。
entries.en: {v:0055}Might be time to ease off. Doesn't look like Mr. Grengal's{n}buying any more, either.

entries.jp: {v:0056}やっぱり、こういうことか。
entries.en: {v:0056}So that's it. Just as I thought.
{v:0057}Who's there?!

entries.jp: {v:0058}アンタ達の悪事、しっかりと押さえたわよ！
entries.en: {v:0058}We've caught you red-handed!

entries.jp: {v:0059}侵入者！？{p}{v:005A}見張りは何をしているんだ？
entries.en: {v:0059}Intruders?!{p}{v:005A}What are the lookouts doing?!

entries.jp: {v:005B}さぁ、観念するんだな！
entries.en: {v:005B}Now give it up!

entries.jp: {v:005C}ええい！{n}ここまできて、捕まってたまるか！
entries.en: {v:005C}Damn it! I'm not getting caught after coming this far!

entries.jp: {v:005D}アタシ達から逃げられると思ってんの！？
entries.en: {v:005D}You think you can get away from us?!

entries.jp: ちょっと！{n}最後まで調べてからにしなさいよ！
entries.en: Hey! Finish looking around before you go!

entries.jp: {v:006B}水晶が崩れた跡みたい。{n}ここでも崩落事故があったのかな？
entries.en: {v:006B}It looks like some crystal collapsed here. Was there a{n}cave-in here too?

entries.jp: {v:006C}う～ん‥‥。{n}そう簡単には、壊れそうもないんだけどなぁ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:006C}Hmm... It doesn't look like it'd break that{n}easily, though...

entries.jp: {v:006D}ここの水晶も、あの人たちが運び出していたみたい。{n}途中まできれいに片づけられてるし‥‥。
entries.en: {v:006D}It looks like those people were hauling out the crystal{n}here too. They've cleared part of it away...

entries.jp: {v:006E}まだ奥があるみたい。{n}力を入れれば、崩して通れそうだよ。
entries.en: {v:006E}It looks like there's more beyond here. With enough{n}force, we could break through.

entries.jp: {v:006F}ちょっとどいてろ。
entries.en: {v:006F}Stand back a minute.

entries.jp: {FFF0}○{FFEE}ボタン連打に集中しろ！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFF0}Circle{FFEE} button--keep mashing it! Concentrate!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFF0}集中失敗！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFF0}Concentration failed!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {FFEE}{FFEB}回目開始{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Attempt {FFEB} begins!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:0070}どりゃあっ！{FFF2}
entries.en: {v:0070}Hyaaah!{FFF2}

entries.jp: {v:0071}わぁ、ウォレスさん、すご～い！
entries.en: {v:0071}Wow, Wallace-san! You're amazing!

entries.jp: {v:0072}奥にも道が続いているみたい。
entries.en: {v:0072}It looks like the passage goes farther in.

entries.jp: {v:0073}行ってみようぜ。
entries.en: {v:0073}Let's take a look.
{v:0074}Huh?! We're going in?

entries.jp: {v:0075}あたりまえでしょ！{n}何のためにここまで来たと思ってんのよ！
entries.en: {v:0075}Of course we are! What do you think we came all this{n}way for?!

entries.jp: {v:0076}だ、だって、また崩れてきたら‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0076}B-but what if it caves in again...?

entries.jp: {v:0077}さ、行くわよ！
entries.en: {v:0077}Come on, let's go!

entries.jp: {FFF5}{v:0078}ふぇ～ん、恐いよぉ‥‥。
entries.en: {FFF5}{v:0078}Waaah... I'm scared...

entries.jp: {v:0079}水晶鉱山の規模と進んだ距離から考えて、{n}ここら辺がちょうど中心だな。
entries.en: {v:0079}Judging by the size of the crystal mine and how far{n}we've come, we're right in the middle.

entries.jp: {v:007A}さすが！{n}昔ここの警備をしていただけのことはあるね？
entries.en: {v:007A}Nice! All that time guarding this place sure paid{n}off, huh?

entries.jp: {v:007B}あらためて言われると、自分の歳を実感するぜ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:007B}Hearing you say it makes me feel my age...

entries.jp: {v:007C}何コレ？{n}人型に水晶がへこんでるよ？
entries.en: {v:007C}What's this? There's a hollow in the crystal shaped like{n}a person!

entries.jp: {v:007D}こんなに大きいんじゃ、巨人だね。
entries.en: {v:007D}At that size, it'd have to be a giant.

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:007E}これ、お兄ちゃんの見た怪物じゃないの！？
entries.en: ...{v:007E}Isn't this the monster you saw, Big Brother?!

entries.jp: {v:007F}間違いないな。{p}{v:0080}２０年前、奴はここから出てきた。{n}そして鉱夫や俺の部下たちを惨殺したんだ。
entries.en: {v:007F}No doubt about it.{p}{v:0080}Twenty years ago, it came out of here. Then it{n}slaughtered the miners and my men.

entries.jp: {v:0081}どうしてここに居たんだろ？{n}それともここで生まれたのかな？
entries.en: {v:0081}Why was it here? Or was it born here?

entries.jp: {v:0082}それは今のところ、何とも言えんな。{n}だが、水晶鉱山から奴が出てきたことだけは{n}間違いねぇ。
entries.en: {v:0082}Can't say yet. But there's no doubt it came out of this{n}crystal mine.

entries.jp: {v:0083}ひょっとして、ここみたいな水晶鉱山が{n}他にもあるのかな？{n}そんで、その中にも怪物がいるとか‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0083}Could there be other crystal mines like this one? And{n}maybe monsters inside them, too...?

entries.jp: {v:0084}それもわからんな‥‥。{n}だが、もしそうだとしたら、水晶鉱山を見つけても、{n}うかつに掘るのは危険だ。
entries.en: {v:0084}Don't know that either... But if there are, digging{n}carelessly into any crystal mine we find could{n}be dangerous.

entries.jp: {v:0085}それじゃ、早く教えてあげなくちゃ！
entries.en: {v:0085}Then we've got to tell them right away!

entries.jp: {v:0086}とにかく国王に報告だな。
entries.en: {v:0086}Either way, we'd better report to the King.

entries.jp: {FFEC}{v:0031}ティピちゃーん、キーック{FFED}
entries.en: {FFEC}{v:0031}Tippi-chan Kiiick!{FFED}

entries.jp: {v:0032}お約束はしないの！
entries.en: {v:0032}We're not doing that old routine!

entries.jp: せっかくここまで来たんだ。{n}徹底的に調査していこうぜ？
entries.en: We've come all this way. Let's give this place a{n}thorough look, eh?
